title: KID TRAVIS - DIAMONDS
htmlContent:
KID TRAVIS has shared a new single called "DIAMONDS." The musician, multi-gifted rapper, and singer continue his clean streak of high-quality releases with this new single. "DIAMONDS" seems to be a chill rap track, but there's much to take away from the lyrics. KID TRAVIS showcases his ability to express sincerity through sharply-crafted songwriting, delivering an offering that provides much replay value. 

The new single leaves listeners wondering where KID TRAVIS finds inspiration. It's his influential upbringing that makes his style stand out. The most outstanding part of the song, however, is the emotion he discloses on the track.

KID TRAVIS's "DIAMONDS" is now available on all streaming outlets.
